versions.title: SERENITY — A Story in Layers
versions.message: One fragrance, a quiet sequence of impressions inspired by the official citrus, floral and musk description. This is a visual concept, not a verified scent progression.

shots.visual: Set SERENITY product-original image at true aspect ratio on a quiet ivory field. A restrained glow enters the frame. A sensory opening is an art-direction device; no literal fruit or top-note order is claimed. Set text in restrained English editorial typography with safe mobile margins.
shots.transition: Fade up from ivory; gentle light reveal.

shots.transition: 150ms dissolve preserving bottle label and aspect ratio.

shots.visual: Warm amber-lit still-life with SERENITY and stone/branch environment used only as mood. A gentle slow zoom or photographic pan suggests softness, not a demonstrated fragrance effect or ingredient origin. Set text in restrained English editorial typography with safe mobile margins.
shots.transition: Gentle transition into warm shadow; no product transformation.

End on the product name and editorial CTA with no price, claim, promotion or simulated generation badge embedded in actual creative copy. Set text in restrained English editorial typography with safe mobile margins.

versions.caption: SERENITY, by Lavish Perfumes. A quieter way to explore fragrance through light, floral feeling and a soft musk-inspired mood. Editorial concept for review; no verified application or performance claim. #LavishPerfumes #SERENITY
